critical_code_review_comments: admin_analytics.py uses an atomic staging-collection swap (insert into monthly_analytics_staging → drop monthly_analytics → rename) to avoid a half-recomputed window — good pattern.
recompute_monthly_analytics is guarded by an asyncio.Lock so concurrent triggers (e.g. simultaneous publish + manual rebuild) coalesce safely.
live-path top-N hydration batches name lookups in one $in per collection per dim — efficient.
Match stage on cache reads always filters on dim:'total' for KPI/monthly, dim:'<x>' for top-N — correctly aligned with the seeding pipeline.

_last_recompute_meta is process-local (module global). After a pod restart status would briefly show finished_at=null/doc_count=0 until next publish or manual rebuild. Consider persisting last meta to mongo if multi-pod observability is required (future-only nit, not blocking).
Frontend Analytics.jsx default range correctly clamps period_from to actual min when 12 months back falls before the earliest available period.
